system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41:56 UTC, maria.lopez ran PowerShell to compress \\FILE-HD-01\Shared\Clients into C:\Users\maria.lopez\AppData\Local\Temp\c.zip; the archive was created shortly afterward.
At 13:45:24 UTC, maria.lopez launched Chrome to sendbox-files.io. The stated service inventory does not approve this file-sharing service.
At 13:48 UTC, WS-MLOPEZ-01 sent about 51 MB through the proxy to sendbox-files.io in a successful CONNECT tunnel. Chrome PID 4896 is associated with the connection.
The sequence of compressing client-share data, opening an unapproved file-sharing service, and sending a similarly large outbound transfer strongly supports apparent unauthorized data exfiltration.

known_telemetry_limitations: The sendbox connection is logged as a TLS CONNECT tunnel; the available records do not expose the encrypted application payload.
The supplied sensor-status information reports a winsec and Sysmon collection outage on WS-LPARK-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC. It does not indicate an outage on WS-MLOPEZ-01.
claims_not_established: The evidence does not establish that the 51 MB transfer contained c.zip, or reveal the archive's contents.
The proxy's successful CONNECT status does not by itself establish that sendbox-files.io stored or accepted a completed upload.
The evidence does not establish whether maria.lopez had authorization or a legitimate business reason for the activity.
additional_evidence_needed: Preserve and examine c.zip, including its contents, size, hash, and source-file metadata.
Obtain browser and endpoint forensic artifacts to determine which file was selected for upload and whether the transfer completed.
Seek sendbox-files.io account and upload records, if available, to identify the recipient, account, and uploaded object.
Confirm with maria.lopez and the relevant data owner whether the transfer was authorized.
